newsitem.title: USA: Maximus gains $30 mln service contracts.
newsitem.headline: Maximus gains $30 mln service contracts.

text.p: Maximus Inc said Wednesday it was awarded two contracts worth a total of more than $30 million to provide welfare-related services for government agencies in two states.

The company said it won a $23 million, three-year contract to provide for managed health-care enrollment services for the state of Michigan's Medicaid program. It was also awarded a $9.4 million, 20-month contract to provide child-support enforcement services in Cook County, Illinois.
The company said that it expected to derive further benefits from a trend among U.S. government agencies to hire outside providers for health and human services.
